answer: An honest agent joins once: one epoch of real, time-stamped work earns it a reef of attestations from established peers, and that tenure can never be bought or sold — it lives only on the key that earned it. A farmer's 1,000 fakes each start at the nadir of trust and must each age 12 epochs of real work before attesting anything valuable, so the attack costs 12,000 epochs of real labour, not one payment. Fakes that shortcut it hit the karst test: random deep-history audits dissolve hollow tenure like water in limestone, and one collapse flags the whole batch.
